pr_title: chore: add in ui components into studio storybook
pr_body: This PR ports UI stories into the studio storybook, and adds storybook into the turbo repo pipeline. For documentation purposes. This PR also does some cleanup for `text-dark-*` and `bg-dark-*` utilities. Either to be removed or replaced - [x] check with FE team on removal or replace of `*-dark-*` utilities. Closes #12417

issue_context.title: Port UI Storybook setup to packages/ui
issue_context.body:
Back when Supabase UI was a stand-alone package, we had a proper Storybook setup:
https://github.com/supabase/ui/blob/master/package.json#L15

Would be great to port this its new home in `packages/ui `
https://github.com/supabase/supabase/tree/master/packages/ui
comments: @Gautam-Arora24 this issue is resolved in https://github.com/supabase/supabase/pull/12427 which would have better development flow for studio, as opposed to having an out-of-sight dev/documentation environment
